designDecisions.decision: Constructed a rectangular water basin with explicit bottom, four perimeter walls, coping and dry deck circuit aligned with the terrace.
designDecisions.limitation: Pool services and planted garden outlook are not represented.

designDecisions.decision: Located the covered outdoor-dining terrace directly beside the rear glazed family-living facade.
designDecisions.limitation: Furniture circulation and kitchen fit-out remain unverified and unbuilt.

designDecisions.decision: Used a real fitted entrance opening, porch and independently supported canopy for a protected arrival.
designDecisions.limitation: Door hardware and weatherproofing are not represented.

designDecisions.decision: Concentrated broad glazing toward the private pool terrace and retained mostly solid front and side enclosure for privacy.
designDecisions.limitation: Thermal, acoustic and solar performance are not simulated.

designDecisions.decision: Balanced the long primary residence datum with a lower, offset covered-dining canopy rather than adding a detached pavilion.
designDecisions.limitation: Visual balance is a design intention, not solver-verified.

designDecisions.decision: A separate reading pavilion was considered but omitted to preserve a compact family-garden composition and prioritize the requested dining canopy.
designDecisions.limitation: No dedicated reading nook is constructed.

designDecisions.decision: Layered tropical planting was not constructed because direct-scene plant and tree output is unavailable.
designDecisions.limitation: The private garden remains an unbuilt landscape reserve.

limitations: Surface areas are per physical element; overlapping surfaces are not additional usable area. Enclosed area, requested-space completeness, pool construction and circulation require architectural review. A renderable model is not a completed building.
